audience: HR and learning teams that report on employees, courses and certificates in Engagedly

useCases.title: Map departments and reporting lines
useCases.text: List employees with their manager or direct reports. Read the departments and job titles of the organization.

useCases.title: Check learner progress for a course
useCases.text: Find a course or playlist, read its sections and items, then read the progress of its learners.

useCases.title: Find certificates that expire soon
useCases.text: List the certificates awarded to employees, filtered by dates or status, and open one to see its authority and validity dates.

useCases.title: Review recognition between employees
useCases.text: List the public praises that employees give each other, for a recognition report.

useCases.title: Audit user permissions
useCases.text: Read the permissions of one user, and list the permissions that exist in the organization.
